readerCopy.headline: The energy is real. The brakes need to be real too.
readerCopy.body:
The workload looks manageable because you feel strong enough to push through it. The argument feels worth finishing because you are certain you can make the other person understand. The late night feels fine until tomorrow morning still starts at eight. Confidence can keep spending tomorrow's time.

Jupiter square Mars can make force feel like proof. Set the limit before adrenaline gets a vote. Push the project, make the case, take the opportunity, then stop at the point you already decided was enough. More effort is not automatically better effort.
